component.name: Dogear
component.summary: Read, highlight and remember your PDFs

description.p: Dogear is a PDF reader for studying. It does what you would do to a paper textbook: highlight in several colors, write notes next to what you highlighted, bookmark pages, fill in the blanks on worksheets and keep general notes about the document. When you are done, export everything to Markdown.

ul.li: A library of every PDF you have opened, searchable by title, folder and the text of your marks
Highlights in five colors, with notes in the sidebar and the page margin
Answer lines: click a blank line in a worksheet and type
Named bookmarks and the PDF's own table of contents
Remembers the page, scroll position and zoom for each file
Keeps the library in one folder you can sync between computers
Never modifies your PDFs; no network access, no telemetry

description.p: Built for Omarchy, where it follows the desktop theme live. On other desktops it uses its own light or dark colors, following the system preference.
